name: TGPSC Group 1
pattern: Prelims: General Studies & Mental Ability, 150 questions, 150 marks, 2½ hours (screening). Mains: General English (qualifying) + 6 descriptive papers × 150 marks, 3 hours each. In English, Telugu and Urdu.

sections.name: General studies & mental ability
topics: Current affairs: regional, national and international
General science; India's achievements in science and technology
Environmental issues; disaster management: prevention and mitigation
World geography, Indian geography and geography of Telangana
History and cultural heritage of India
Society, culture, heritage, arts and literature of Telangana
Social exclusion; rights issues (gender, caste, tribe, disability) and inclusive policies
Logical reasoning, analytical ability and data interpretation
Logical reasoning, mental ability and data interpretation

sections.name: General English (qualifying)
topics: Grammar, comprehension, précis, letter writing (10th class standard)

sections.name: Paper I: General Essay
topics: Historical and cultural heritage of India

sections.name: Paper III: Indian Society, Constitution & Governance
Paper V: Science & Technology and Data Interpretation
topics: Role and impact of science and technology

sections.name: Paper VI: Telangana Movement & State Formation
